name: Rosanna Malowney
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Rosanna is a person-centred counsellor with extensive experience supporting individuals through a wide range of challenges, including drug and alcohol dependency, mental health issues, and general life difficulties. Her approach is rooted in empathy, authenticity, and respect, creating a safe and non-judgmental space where clients can explore their thoughts and emotions at their own pace. She brings a compassionate and client-led approach to each session, believing in each person’s capacity for growth, resilience, and self-understanding.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Deborah Cameron
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: My Psychotherapy Counselling Clinic (PCC) is a registered provider for NDIS and WorkSafe. In addition, work from time to time with clients referred by the DJCS. PCC specialises in supporting clients with trauma, ADHD, autism, bipolar and depression.

name: Christina Kioulafas
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I work with all ages but my specialty children and young people with a focus on infant mental health. I have a lot of experience with trauma, PTSD, attachment, identity and working with relationships.

name: Briony Tronson
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a Creative Arts Therapist (AThR) and Certified Practising Counsellor (PACFA) with a trauma-informed, neurodivergent-affirming approach to therapy. I work with individuals experiencing complex trauma, CPTSD, mental health challenges, and neurodivergence, including those navigating psychosocial disabilities, chronic health conditions, and life transitions. I have experience working with adults and NDIS participants, offering personalised therapeutic support for those with complex trauma, neurodivergence, and mental health recovery. Key Areas of Focus: Complex Trauma & PTSD Neurodivergence-Affirming Therapy Somatic Awareness & Mindfulness Mental Health & Wellbeing Creative Arts Therapy (multi-modal)
